SELECT * FROM ( SELECT T.TEAM_ID teamId, T.TEAM_LEADER_NO teamLeader, U.USER_NAME leaderName, T.TEAM_NAME title, T.TEAM_CONTENT content, T.TEAM_CATEGORY category, T.CREATED_AT createdAt, PROFILE_IMG leaderProfile, ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END FROM TB_TEAM_APPLICANT S WHERE S.APPLICANT_NO = #{userNo} AND S.TEAM_ID = T.TEAM_ID ) AS canApplyToTeam FROM TB_TEAM T JOIN TB_USER U ON (T.TEAM_LEADER_NO = U.USER_NO) LEFT JOIN TB_PROFILE P ON (T.TEAM_LEADER_NO = P.USER_NO)
WHERE T.CREATED_AT < TO_DATE(#{lastTimeStamp}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
AND
WHERE
T.TEAM_CATEGORY = #{category}
ORDER BY T.CREATED_AT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 10
